rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP. XCIX. Of the Rectification of a Nativity by Animodar
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: New numbered natal chapter teaches Animodar birth-time rectification.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed XCIX corresponds to sequential/editorial C; it is not part of prior Trutine chapter.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Many and those very learned ... use
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says numerous learned astrologers use Animodar to amend estimated natal time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Practitioner prevalence claimed historically; no quantified sample or accuracy.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: erected your Scheame ... estimative time
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The student begins with a natal chart erected for the estimated birth time.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Uncorrected chart is the input; do not assume its clock or houses are accurate.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Ptolomey directs
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly attributes the following syzygy selection procedure to Ptolemy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original Ptolemaic source parity is not independently authenticated by this batch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: last new Moone ... before the Birth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If the preceding syzygy was a new Moon, examine its zodiacal sign and degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: New-Moon path distinct from full-Moon path.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if it was a full Moon
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If the preceding syzygy was a full Moon, select the relevant luminary's zodiacal sign and degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Full Moon is an opposition; planet selection additionally depends on which light was above the horizon.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: either of the lights ... above the earth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For a preceding full Moon, examine the Sun or Moon that was above the earth at the opposition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Horizon-based conditional criterion; no actual ephemeris calculated here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet ... most dignities ... essential in that degree
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Determine which natal planet possesses the most essential dignities at the chosen syzygy degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Rule depends on domicile/exaltation/triplicity/terms and a historical dignity table; score system not reproduced fully.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: degrees he is in ... nearer ... cusp ascendant ... Mid-heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Compare the candidate planet's natal longitude with the degrees at the Ascendant and Midheaven cusps.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Must compare zodiacal circular angular distances, not the sheer raw numbers without wrap handling.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nearer ... cusp ascendant ... place so many degrees ascending
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If the planet lies closer to the Ascendant, set the proposed ascending zodiacal degree equal to that planet's position.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Birth time must then be adjusted to reconstruct the stated Ascendant; not independently proven.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if ... nearer ... Mid-heaven then ... make degrees of Mid-heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If closer to the Midheaven, use the planet's natal zodiacal position as the corrected Midheaven.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Distinct output and house angle from the Ascendant branch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: vary your former figure according to either of those Angles
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Recompute the estimated horoscope to satisfy the selected corrected cusp.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A deterministic reconstruction requirement once original ephemeris/method pinned.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: two Planets have equall dignities
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If two planets tie in essential dignity at the degree, Lilly supplies a further criterion.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Tie resolution rather than independent confirmation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: accept ... who is neerest in degrees to the Ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Break an essential-dignity tie in favor of the planet nearer the Ascendant.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source tie rule favors Ascendant; it does not prescribe an empirical statistical tie-break.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: previously estimated and corrected chart may differ
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: This can change the estimated time or angle if the planet's natal placement differs from the initial cusp.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Direction and magnitude of actual clock shift remain dependent on chart reconstruction.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: our Nativity was rectified by accidents
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly explicitly says this merchant's natal figure was already rectified from significant life events.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Animodar is being compared retrospectively against an accident-adjusted chart, not an independent truth.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: estimative time ... did not differ ... above one degree
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says the initially estimated time differed from his accident-rectified figure by no more than about one rising degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: This is a claimed agreement between his own procedures, not actual independently recorded birth-time error.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: 15 September 1616 being Sunday
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He dates the relevant preceding syzygy to Sunday 15 September 1616.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source date; Julian-day and ephemeris parity not independently computed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: opposition Moon or full Moon foure dayes before birth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He specifies an opposition/full Moon four days before the merchant's September 19 birth.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The chosen full Moon is a retrospective lookup.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: about eleven of clock day time
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The example gives the preceding opposition's time at roughly 11 o'clock in daytime.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical clock/location ambiguity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun ... 2 degrees 32 minutes Libra ... above earth
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: At the full Moon, the Sun at about Libra 2°32′ was the luminary above the horizon, so Lilly selects that degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-specified luminary selection, not independently calculated syzygy data.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Table of Essential dignities page 104
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He directs checking his dignity table at Libra 2°32′.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Points back to Book I source; table must be available to reproduce the dignity score.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn ... exaltation and triplicity ... terme
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims Saturn is the principal dignity-holder there through exaltation, triplicity and term.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Specific traditional dignity predicates requiring source and chart-parity verification.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn ... principall ruler of that full Moon
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly selects Saturn as the Animodar planet for this syzygy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical rule application, not observed correction outcome.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: we shall find him in 9 ...
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly describes Saturn's natal position as near nine degrees of a zodiacal sign in the merchant's source figure.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original sign glyph needs deliberate standalone diplomatic confirmation; do not guess its label in this data row.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neerer degree ascending then ... Mid-heaven
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: For Saturn, the comparison favors the estimated Ascendant rather than the Midheaven.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original circular distances and timestamps have not been independently recomputed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Ascendant ... ninth of Capricorn and 2 min
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He infers a corrected Ascendant near Capricorn 9°02′ from Saturn's position.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-asserted result, not a validated birth time.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: had we accepted of Venus to have most dignities
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He notes some astrologers could instead award Venus the most essential dignities.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source explicitly acknowledges competing dignity attribution.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: a strange concurrence
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He suggests Venus would produce an intriguing agreement.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No specified independently authenticated truth criterion or supporting record.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: neither Trutine of Hermes or this ... so sure foundation ... Accidents
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He rates neither Animodar nor Trutine as well-founded as accident-based rectification.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Explicit negative comparative confidence, despite preceding worked illustration.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Children ... before any accidents happen ... use this way and the other
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When rectifying a child's chart before notable life events exist, he says the two preliminary syzygy/Trutine methods may still be used.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Pragmatic fallback, not an endorsement of proven future predictive validity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP. C The Rectification ... by Accidents ... Astrologicall Speculum
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A new numbered chapter begins at original PDF541/printed507 on correcting a natal figure using significant life events.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Next printed C/editorial CI; do not merge its tests and source statements into the Animodar batch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: transits and profections ... could never find verity
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next chapter opens with Lilly questioning techniques based on transits and profections due to lack of practical success.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A negative claim belonging to the next chapter; audit all qualifying conditions there.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: collect eminent accidents certain time year month day
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next method prioritizes collecting dated major life events, preferably with exact dates.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Navigation only; future source batch must distinguish fitting known events from predicting unseen events.
